title: Route live records readers to the athena/records worktree
summary: Define the records worktree path once in athena-data paths.rs beside repo_state_dir. Add load_current forms to Records::load and RecordSet::load, move the live callers to them, and fall back to in-tree records/ only when the worktree is absent. The site generator reads studies/, so it stays unchanged. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria run readers against a worktree that differs from in-tree records/.
Full cargo test, clippy and fmt are required.
An xtask scan test enforces the single path.
The site output and status/forecast without records/ are checked as outcomes.
Behavior criteria name the commands to run.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The cutover (20261025-001232-vesh) is assumed landed or the fallback covers its absence. Whether the branch exists should be checked against the code, not assumed.
The call-site inventory comes from a grep of Records::load, RecordSet::load, read_records and join("records") over 40 files. Many of those are tests, which keep reading in-tree records/ as fixtures.
The deliverable list follows the earlier critic's file list plus the request's Files line, so scope findings do not recur.
The site generator reads studies/firstmate-work-handling (xtask/src/site.rs), not records/, so it is marked unaffected.
Goal: readers see current records, not a stale checkout. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test puts different records in the worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that each moved reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, xtask walltime, status, auditor, reading, scope_guard, run, manage, proposals, audience, review, hestia, steward, code_health, work_decisions, backtest, drain) returns the worktree's records. Run cargo test --locked.

With no worktree present, each moved reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. athena status and a forecast succeed on a scratch checkout with no records/ in the working tree, using only the worktree. Run cargo test --locked.
The worktree path is defined once, in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs next to repo_state_dir. No non-test reader joins records/ itself outside paths.rs and the fallback.

An xtask scan test (cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan) fails on a planted direct read of records/ in non-test code and passes on the real tree. It matches reader shapes (join("records"), read_records(<repo dir>), Records/RecordSet::load(), so citation strings in steward.rs and work_decisions.rs and the gate invariant.rs BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME path are not flagged. The test was run once against the real tree.

The study site generator is unchanged: xtask/src/site.rs and its root are untouched, and the site output is identical when built with records/ removed from the tree. Run cargo run -p xtask -- site with records/ present and with it absent, and compare the outputs.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and the full cargo test --locked pass.
docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move, the fallback and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.

out_of_scope: Rerooting the study site generator (xtask/src/site.rs), which reads studies/ and not records/
The cutover itself (20261025-001232-vesh) and creating the athena/records branch
Test fixtures that deliberately read in-tree records/
Citation strings such as records/jobs labels in steward.rs and work_decisions.rs
departures: This is a wide sweep across about 30 files with a new scan test, and the prior attempt failed in planning. Cost and time are well above the reference, and pass probability is lower.
